rulings.why: p372-strip1600.jpg system 4, stanza 1 row: word 2 'Holy' is capitalised because it opens the words to be sung after 'Sing,' (the threefold holy, a quote with no quote marks), not a poem line. The metre 7.6.7.6.D counts 7 syllables from 'Sing' to the third 'holy' and 6 from 'To' to 'One', where the database opens its lines 7 and 8.
